17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 2804 North Lakewood Avenue, Chicago, IL
Proposed Zoning: | _RM-S Residential Multi-Unit District

Lot Area: Parcel 1: 17,928 sq. ft.
Parcel 2: 5,976
23,904 sq. ft. total

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to construct eight (8) private rooftop penthouses
to provide access to private deck space on the roof of the existing two-story
multi-unit residential building. The proposed penthouses will contain a total
of 3,016 sq. ft. of new floor area and the height of the building will measure
38 ft. The footprint of the existing two-story residential building and
detached garage will remain without change. The subject property is a
Transit Served Location. The existing twenty (20) unit residential building
will continue to be supported by twenty (20) garage parking spaces at 1301
West Wolfram. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative
Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1003-EE and 17-13-
1101-B of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to
increase the off-street parking requirement for a Transit Served Location
from 50% (ten (10) parking spaces) to 100% (twenty (20) parking spaces),
located at 1301 West Wolfram Street, reduce the total combined side
setback to zero, reduce the front setback to zero, reduce the rear setback to
zero, and is seeking all relief necessary, as allowed by the code, for the
attached plans.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 34,340 square feet (1.92 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 896.4 square feet per D.U.
(20 residential units)

(C)  *The amount of off-street parking: 20 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (Diversey Bus
Route). Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to increase the
off-street parking requirement from 50% (ten (10) parking spaces) to 100% (twenty
(20) parking spaces).

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: zero feet (existing to remain)
b. Side Setbacks:
North Side: zero feet (existing to remain)
South Side: zero feet (existing to remain)
\ c. Rear Setback: zero (existing to remain)

*The Applicant is seeking to reduce the total combined side setback to zero, reduce
the front setback to zero, and reduce the rear setback to zero.
